_comment: OutputRead benchmark row inventory: the retained matrix, with an owner per row. Unlike producer_inventory.json this is NOT a frozen L1B contract -- OutputRead is a performance family, and test_benchmark_contract.cmake step 10 gates it on the producer contract (clean exit, published row, fail-closed on missing data) rather than on frozen numbers. What this file adds is ownership: step 10d asserts the registered OutputRead rows are exactly these, so a row cannot be added without an owner recorded here. THRESHOLD: rows carry the harness's per-row baseline tolerance, seeded by --slop (default 10%) when _baseline.txt is regenerated and compared on a non-regenerate run. CI's benchmark job runs with --regenerate and therefore publishes rather than gates; the CPU pass added to that job is the scheduled consumer, and its numbers land in the benchmark_results artifact.
